name: project_media_gallery
title: Project Media Gallery
description: Gallery of a project's media from src/content/img/projects/<media.path>/<source_gallery_dir_devices>/ (or src/content/vid/projects/... for videos). "devices": desktop/phone screenshots rendered in card_post_project_visual_devices_website mockups; "images": plain images; "videos": video players (project_block_video). Can auto-find sub galleries and render them as one list or one list per folder. Grid columns via utility_grid_listing (max 4 by default). Images open in the popup gallery.
